issue: Does the Brady v. Maryland disclosure obligation apply to a pretrial suppression hearing?

sides.position: Brady applies to suppression hearings (the excerpt does not state which side Thomas takes)
cases: United States v. Thomas, 835 F.3d 730 (7th Cir. 2016)

quote: This court has not determined whether Brady applies to a suppression hearing, and circuits are split on the issue.
cite: United States v. Rafael Puebla-Zamora, 996 F.3d 535 (8th Cir. 2021)
